host.description: Technical name of the host prototype.

name.description: Visible name of the host prototype. Default: host property value.

status.description: Status of the host prototype. Possible values are: 0 - (default) monitored host; 1 - unmonitored host.

inventory_mode.description: Host inventory population mode. Possible values are: -1 - (default) disabled; 0 - manual; 1 - automatic.

discover.description: Host prototype discovery status. Possible values: 0 - (default) new hosts will be discovered; 1 - new hosts will not be discovered and existing hosts will be marked as lost.

custom_interfaces.description: Source of interfaces for hosts created by the host prototype. Possible values: 0 - (default) inherit interfaces from parent host; 1 - use host prototypes custom interfaces.

uuid.description: Universal unique identifier, used for linking imported host prototypes to already existing ones. Used only for host prototypes on templates. Auto-generated, if not given.

ruleid.description: ID of the LLD rule that the host prototype belongs to.

groupLinks.description: Group links to be created for the host prototype.

groupPrototypes.description: Group prototypes to be created for the host prototype.

macros.description: User macros to be created for the host prototype.

templates.description: Templates to be linked to the host prototype. The templates must have the templateid property defined.

groupLink.description: The group link object links a host prototype with a host group.

groupPrototype.description: The group prototype object defines a group that will be created for a discovered host.

hostPrototypeMacro.description: The host macro object defines a macro available on a host, host prototype or template.

type.description: Type of macro. Possible values: 0 - (default) Text macro; 1 - Secret macro; 2 - Vault secret.

dns.description: DNS name used by the interface. Required if the connection is made via DNS. Can contain macros.

ip.description: IP address used by the interface. Required if the connection is made via IP. Can contain macros.

main.description: Whether the interface is used as default on the host. Only one interface of some type can be set as default on a host. Possible values are: 0 - not default; 1 - default.

port.description: Port number used by the interface. Can contain user and LLD macros.

type.description: Interface type. Possible values are: 1 - agent; 2 - SNMP; 3 - IPMI; 4 - JMX.

useip.description: Whether the connection should be made via IP. Possible values are: 0 - connect using host DNS name; 1 - connect using host IP address for this host interface.

details.description: Additional object for interface. Required if interface type is SNMP.

customInterfaceDetails.description: The details object for a custom SNMP interface.

version.description: SNMP interface version. Possible values are: 1 - SNMPv1; 2 - SNMPv2c; 3 - SNMPv3.

bulk.description: Whether to use bulk SNMP requests. Possible values are: 0 - don't use bulk requests; 1 - (default) use bulk requests.

community.description: SNMP community. Used only by SNMPv1 and SNMPv2 interfaces.

securityname.description: SNMPv3 security name. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

securitylevel.description: SNMPv3 security level. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values are: 0 - (default) noAuthNoPriv; 1 - authNoPriv; 2 - authPriv.

authpassphrase.description: SNMPv3 authentication passphrase. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

privpassphrase.description: SNMPv3 privacy passphrase. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

authprotocol.description: SNMPv3 authentication protocol. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values are: 0 - (default) MD5; 1 - SHA1; 2 - SHA224; 3 - SHA256; 4 - SHA384; 5 - SHA512.

privprotocol.description: SNMPv3 privacy protocol. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values are: 0 - (default) DES; 1 - AES128; 2 - AES192; 3 - AES256; 4 - AES192C; 5 - AES256C.

contextname.description: SNMPv3 context name. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

templateRef.description: Reference to an existing template. Must have the templateid property defined.
